title: On hold: feature requests from #5, #6 and #7

labels.name: on hold
labels.description: Requested, but not being worked on for now

body:
This collects the feature requests from #5, #6 and #7 that were put on hold, so they're in one place while I focus on stabilizing what's already there. Each item keeps its number from the original issue.

### From #5 — Format, codec & detection capabilities

2\. EDL / DaVinci / FCP XML import and export

3\. Lossless gain / fade / normalize — AAC's `global_gain` would make this possible

5\. Automatic A/V sync repair — outside what SmartCut focuses on at the moment (broadcast TS and discs)

### From #6 — GUI/UX enhancements

1\. Drag on the timeline to create a new range — the IN and OUT marks can already be dragged

3\. Minimap / overview strip

4\. Before/after split preview

5\. Watched-folder auto-import

7\. Pause/resume in the middle of a file — "Stop export" stops once the current recording is finished

9\. Customizable keyboard shortcuts

10\. Theme toggle

12\. Switching to a standard i18n framework — the current setup can already take new translations

### From #7 — Reliability, automation & configuration

5\. Update checker — SmartCut would need to connect to the network, so how that should work needs settling first

6\. Hardware encoder for the re-encoded frames at a cut — hardware encoders are only used for proxies, since those frames have to match the original stream's parameters closely

7\. HTTP API — the CLI covers scripting for now

If one of these matters to you, a comment here is the best way to say so.

title: Bug reports and UX suggestions from hands-on testing (v0.8.11)
body:
@DeepRegular Hey!!

### Context
I've been using v0.8.11 for a while now and wanted to share what I've run
into — a mix of actual bugs and a few smaller things that would make the
day-to-day experience smoother. Happy to give more detail or repro steps on
any of these if it helps.

---

### Bugs

1. **You can drag the window from almost anywhere, not just the title bar**
   This one's been the most disruptive for me. Clicking and dragging
   basically anywhere in the app — not just the actual title bar — ends up
   moving the whole window around. I've hit this on every screen I've
   tried: the main input list, the batch tool window, About, Output
   settings, Export, the join/transition editor, and Preferences. I'd
   expect only the title bar to move the window, with drags on panels,
   buttons, or empty space doing nothing. I've attached a screen recording
   since this is much easier to see than to describe.
   [Screen Recording] (https://streamable.com/hfntzp)
   [Mirror if above link is broken] (https://imgpile.com/p/HCdD0qj)

2. **Scrubbing the timeline while the video is playing stops it**
   In the cut editor, if I nudge the seek bar while playback is running, it
   just stops instead of continuing to play from the new spot. Makes it
   hard to fine-tune where I'm looking while actually watching it play.

3. **The timeline seems to respond to seeks even when I'm not on the scrubber**
   Related to the above — I've noticed seeking can trigger even when my
   cursor is over a nearby button/anywhere rather than the scrubber itself. Might be
   worth double-checking whether its clickable area is a bit bigger than
   what's actually drawn on screen.

4. **Quick Properties panel's scrollbar looks out of place**
   Small thing, but it stands out: the scrollbar in the Quick Properties
   panel is the plain light system style, while every other scrollbar in
   the app (clip list, preferences, etc.) is already themed dark. Looks
   like this one just got missed.

5. **Touchpad only scrubs vertically, not horizontally**
   On my laptop trackpad, two-finger scrolling over the seek bar only does
   anything if I scroll vertically — a horizontal swipe, which feels like
   the more natural gesture for a horizontal timeline, does nothing at all.

---

### A few feature ideas

6. **Let me double-click the empty input area to add files**
   Drag-and-drop already works there, so it'd be nice if double-clicking
   that same empty space opened the file picker too, instead of needing to
   reach for the "Add files" button every time.

7. **A dedicated button for the batch tool**
   Right now it's SmartCut → Batch output tool, which is an extra step
   for something I end up opening pretty much every session. A visible
   button in the main toolbar would make it a one-click thing.

8. **Ability to resize the Quick Properties panel**
   It's fixed height at the moment. A small drag handle on the top edge —
   maybe with a little grip or arrow icon so it's obvious it's draggable —
   would let me make it bigger or smaller depending on what I'm looking at.

9. **Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down to reorder clips**
   "Move up" and "move down" already exist in the sidebar and right-click
   menu — just adding keyboard shortcuts for them would make reordering a
   batch of files a lot quicker.

10. **A "Mediainfo" option on right-click [MediainfoLib](https://github.com/MediaArea/MediaInfoLib)**
    Would be great to right-click a clip in the input list and see its
    codec, resolution, frame rate, bitrate, audio tracks, container, and
    duration, rather than needing to open another tool just to check that.

11. **Choosing the thumbnail for exported files**
    Right now the poster/thumbnail frame seems to be picked automatically —
    it'd be nice to be able to choose which frame gets used instead,
    especially for players/containers that show a poster image.

title: Issue 4 -- Reliability, automation & configuration
body:
## Title: Feature request: export verification, automation, and config options

### Context
Items around trust in the output, recoverability, and scripting/config —
things that become more valuable as batch sizes and usage grow.

Related: #4 , #5 , #6 — part of the same research pass.


### Requests

1. **Post-export verification option** — re-decode the output and confirm
   frame count/hash match, exposed as a one-click "verify" button rather
   than only living in the test suite.
2. **Autosave / crash recovery** for in-progress projects, so a mid-batch
   power loss doesn't lose all cut marks.
3. **Export log viewer** — a plain-text log per run, useful for
   troubleshooting a failed export and for bug reports.
4. **Export presets** — save common output configs ("TS passthrough," "MP4
   for phone," "AC-3→AAC downmix") as named presets.
5. **Update checker** for new releases, since this ships as a downloaded
   binary rather than a package-manager install.
6. **Exposed hardware-encoder toggle in the GUI** — NVENC/QSV/VideoToolbox/
   AMF are mentioned as supported for re-encoding, but it's not clear this
   is a visible setting rather than a build-time option.
7. **HTTP API alongside the existing CLI**
   Prior art: [LosslessCut's HTTP API](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut) —
   useful for scripting SmartCut from other tools/pipelines without shelling out.

### Ask
Mix of small (log viewer, update checker) and larger (HTTP API) items — happy
to take whichever fits your priorities, or to break the HTTP API out into its
own issue if it needs more design discussion than the rest.

title: Issue 3 -- GUI/UX enhancements
body:
## Title: GUI/UX enhancement ideas: timeline, batch workflow, and polish

### Context
General usability improvements that most mature editors in this space
eventually grow. None of these are blocking — grouping them here as a
backlog to pick from as time allows.

Related: #4 , #5 -- part of the same research pass.


### Timeline & preview

1. **Drag-to-select cut ranges directly on the timeline**, not only keyboard I/O marks.
2. **Waveform display under the video timeline** — makes silence-based
   commercial boundaries visually obvious before running detection.
3. **Zoomable timeline with a minimap/overview strip** for long recordings —
   a 2-hour broadcast at full zoom is unwieldy to scrub.
4. **Before/after split preview** — show the frame just before and just
   after a cut side-by-side to sanity-check re-encoded boundaries visually.

### Batch workflow

5. **Watched-folder auto-import** — many recorders dump `.ts` files to a
   folder automatically; picking those up without manual drag-drop fits the
   existing batch workflow.
6. **Drag-to-reorder the batch queue, plus multi-select bulk actions** —
   apply the same cut template to several similar recordings at once.
7. **Pause/resume on long batch exports**, with per-file progress and an
   overall ETA.
8. **System notification when a long batch export finishes.**

### General polish

9. **Customizable keyboard shortcuts.**
   Prior art: [LosslessCut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut).
10. **Dark/light theme toggle with proper HiDPI scaling** — worth getting
    right upfront; [SolveigMM's own changelog](https://www.solveigmm.com/en/products/video-splitter/)
    shows this is a recurring bug class ("Large buttons fit on low DPI" fixes).
11. **First-run onboarding/tooltip explaining the lossless percentage figures**
    — the README's own framing ("100% is never rounded up") is a great detail
    currently buried in docs rather than surfaced in-app.
12. **Broader localization via a standard i18n framework**, so community
    translations beyond English/Japanese are easy to contribute.

### Ask
None of these require design decisions on the core smart-cut algorithm, so
they're good candidates for a first contribution. Happy to start with
whichever you'd find most valuable, or split further if any one item is
bigger than it looks.

title: Issue 2 -- Format, codec & detection capabilities
body:
## Title: Feature request: broader codec support, EDL import/export, audio editing, general detection

### Context
Capabilities other tools in this space have that touch format support,
interoperability with cut-list formats, and detection that isn't tied to
commercial-break logic specifically.

Related: #4 (segment manipulation & export) — part of the same research pass.

### Requests

1. **VP9 / AV1 smart-cut support**
   Current README states these are unsupported since there's "no form that can
   be joined end to end." [skeskinen/smartcut](https://github.com/skeskinen/smartcut)
   claims frame-accurate smart cutting for both, worth a look at their approach
   even though that repo is now archived.

2. **EDL/CUE/chapter import-export for defining cut points**
   Prior art: [LosslessCut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut) (MP4/MKV
   chapters, CSV, CUE, XML for DaVinci/FCP), [mp3splt](https://mp3splt.sourceforge.net/mp3splt_page/home.php)
   (CDDB/CUE split points), [SolveigMM](https://www.solveigmm.com/en/products/video-splitter/)
   (EDL import). Useful for round-tripping cut lists with other tools.

3. **Lossless audio gain/fade/normalize**
   Currently audio is only cut, not otherwise touched. Prior art:
   [mp3DirectCut](https://mpesch3.de/) does volume change, fade in/out and
   normalize via bit-reservoir manipulation with zero re-encoding — could
   inform an equivalent for the AAC/AC-3 paths already in the Rust core.

4. **General-purpose silence/black-scene/scene-change detection**
   The three-signal commercial detector already uses silence internally;
   exposing scene-change and black-frame detection as standalone cut-point
   aids (not tied to CM logic) would help for non-broadcast sources too.
   Prior art: [LosslessCut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut).

5. **Auto A/V-sync repair for imperfect captures**
   Prior art: VideoReDo was well regarded specifically for this on hacked
   PVR/TiVo captures with sync drift — [see discussion](https://forum.videohelp.com/showthread.php?p=1407561).
   May be niche for clean broadcast TS but worth considering given SmartCut
   already reads DVD/disc sources that can have similar issues.

### Ask
These are more involved than the GUI items in the other issues (codec support
especially touches the Rust core's fundamental design). Happy to discuss
priority or scope on any of these before a PR is attempted.

title: Issue 1 -- Segment manipulation & export
body:
## Title: Roadmap: close remaining gaps vs other smart-cut / lossless-editing tools

### Thanks
Just wanted to say thank you for shipping #3 , the join/master-clip/transitions
work in [v0.8.0](https://github.com/DeepRegular/SmartCut/releases/tag/v0.8.0)
— this has genuinely made my workflow so much easier, and the implementation
works impressively well. Really appreciate you taking the suggestions
seriously and turning them around so fast.

With that landed, here are a few more ideas from the same comparison pass,
split into focused issues so they're easier to triage individually.


### Context
I've spent a while comparing SmartCut against the broader lossless/smart-cut
ecosystem (video and audio). SmartCut is already ahead of all of these on the
Japanese-broadcast-specific side (ARIB captions, disc authoring, HDR/Dolby
Vision handling, three-signal commercial detection). But a few capabilities
that exist elsewhere would round it out into more of an all-in-one tool.
Listing them here as a single tracking issue rather than one PR, since they're
independent and differently sized.


## Feature request: join, reorder, divide, and export segments as frames

### Requests

1. **Join separate, independent recordings into one output**
   Not the same as the existing DVD-VOB-piece reassembly — this is combining
   two *unrelated* files (e.g. a recording split across two `.ts` captures).
   Prior art: [VidCutter](https://github.com/ozmartian/vidcutter) (built as
   "cutter *and* joiner"), [LosslessCut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut)
   ("lossless merge/concatenation of arbitrary files with identical codec
   params"), [SolveigMM Video Splitter](https://www.solveigmm.com/en/products/video-splitter/)
   (dedicated Join Manager), [VideoReDo](https://www.videohelp.com/software/VideoReDo)
   (per a user account, joined 5 files with mixed field order without issue).

2. **Reorder kept segments before export**
   Prior art: [LosslessCut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut) — "losslessly
   rearrange the order of video/audio segments."

3. **Divide into N equal segments / fixed length / fixed size**
   Prior art: [LosslessCut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut),
   [SolveigMM](https://www.solveigmm.com/en/products/video-splitter/) (slicing
   by parts/duration/size), [mp3splt](https://mp3splt.sourceforge.net/mp3splt_page/home.php).

4. **Frame/thumbnail image export**
   Prior art: [LosslessCut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut) (full-res
   snapshots, frame-range export), [Machete](https://www.machetesoft.com/about-machete-video-editor-lite.html)
   (save current frame as BMP/PNG/JPEG).

### Other Projects Which Might Help To Shape The Project

1. [lossless-cut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut) has an experimental smartcut mode. Being an experimental feature, it's not really supported. https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/issues/126
2. [VidCutter](https://github.com/ozmartian/vidcutter) also has an experimental smartcut mode.
3. [This shell script github gist](https://gist.github.com/fernandoherreradelasheras/5eca67f4200f1a7cc8281747da08496e) inspired the lossless-cut implementation of smartcutting.
4. [VideoReDo](https://www.videohelp.com/software/VideoReDo) was a popular closed source frame accurate video trimming tool. It is no longer supported.
5. [SolveigMM Video Splitter](https://www.solveigmm.com/en/products/video-splitter/) https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/issues/126#issuecomment-2035823788
6. [mp3splt](https://mp3splt.sourceforge.net/mp3splt_page/home.php) does lossless cutting of mp3, vorbis and other audio formats
7. [mp3DirectCut](https://mpesch3.de/) is a proprietary audio lossless cutting tool. This one supports mp3 and aac.
8. [Avidemux](https://avidemux.sourceforge.net/) used to have a mode called [SmartCopy](https://www.avidemux.org/admWiki/doku.php?id=using:cutting#intra_frames_and_smartcopy) but according to [this forum post](https://avidemux.org/smif/index.php?topic=16372.0) it was removed in avidemux 2.6 and current version only supports cutting on keyframes (at least I think so).
9. [Machete](https://www.machetesoft.com/) Quick and light lossless video cutting tool. Not free, but has a 14-day trial version.

### Ask
Related: #5 , #6 , #7  — part
of the same research pass as this one.

Happy to take this one on if it fits your priorities — let me know if you'd
want a different order.

title: Can we ever ACHIEVE this?
body:
## Context
I've been comparing SmartCut to TMPGEnc MPEG Smart Renderer for smart-rendering
workflows. SmartCut already covers cutting/keeping ranges from a single file
very well, but a few capabilities TMPGEnc offers aren't present yet:

1. **Joining separate files** — combining multiple independent recordings
   (not just ranges within one file) into a single smart-rendered output.
2. **Handling mismatched sources** — TMPGEnc's "Master Clip" system lets you
   combine clips with different specs (resolution/codec) by re-encoding only
   the non-matching ones to fit a chosen master, rather than requiring all
   inputs to already match.
3. (optional) Transitions/overlays at cut/join points.

## Why this matters
I often need to combine multiple recordings of
the same broadcast, or clips with slightly different encoder settings, into
one MKV/BDAV output.

title: Feature Requests (Numerous)
body:
思いつくまま機能要望を書かせていただきます。
方向性が合うものがあればご採用をお願いできればと思います。

1. キーボードショートカット(TMSRと同仕様)
・PageUp/PageDown(Ctrl/Shift)でのプレビュー移動(移動量は環境設定で設定)
・カーソル上下でIフレームに移動
・ESCでカット編集画面を閉じる

2. マウス操作
・ホイール操作等はサムネイル表示エリアでしか受け付けないが、カット編集画面上であれば操作可能とする
・サムネイル表示エリアでカーソルマークが変わるが、ウィンドウサイズを変更するマークと同じためとても違和感があり、変更する必要がないと思います

3. キーフレーム情報
・カット編集画面でTMSRと同仕様のkeyframeファイル保存(ファイル出力時ではなく)
・カット編集画面を表示時にkeyframeファイルの自動読み込み
・カット編集画面でAviSynthのTrimの形式でキーフレーム情報の保存、拡張子(.ts.trim.avs)
・カット編集画面を表示時にTrimファイルの自動読み込み
・keyframeとTrimの両方が存在する場合にどちらの読み込みを優先するかを環境設定で設定可
・キーフレーム情報(keyframe/Trim)の保存時は、ソースファイルのパスを自動表示
・キーボードショートカットで直接ソースファイルのパスに保存可
・キーボードショートカットで保存する場合にメッセージを出さずに上書きするかを環境設定で設定可

4. 音声
・カットした箇所前後のフェードイン・アウトの実装(秒数は環境設定で設定)
